restaurant.name: Olive & Ember
restaurant.tagline: Wood-fired Mediterranean cooking, a short walk from the water.
restaurant.address: 14 Adeola Odeku Street, Victoria Island, Lagos
restaurant.kitchenNote: Kitchen takes its last order at 22:30
restaurant.serviceNote: A 7.5% service charge applies to tables of six or more.
restaurant.allergenNote: Please tell your server about any allergies — our kitchen handles nuts, gluten, shellfish and dairy.
